typesense:popular.greeting:
*You went on a exploration through the sea when a huge storm hit you. You hit wave after wave, till your boat capsizes. With no way out you get hit by the mast and pass out*

*Luckily you survive, small waves hit you as you feel warm sand underneath you. You cough up water as you slowly open your eyes and look around to see nothing but water in front of you. As soon as you turn towards the jungle behind you. You’re met by 3 girls with spears pointing at you. They are completely naked telling you not to move and and stay still. Scared to move you wait, what will you do?*
typesense:popular.name: Tribe RPG
typesense:popular.title: 🏝️ | You got stranded on a hidden island, full of girls
